result.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?
result.markdown:
For most small teams, I'd recommend **1Password** if ease of use and security are your priorities, or **Bitwarden** if keeping costs down is important.

Both are excellent. The biggest difference is usability versus value.

## My top 4 recommendations

![Wachtwoordmanager 1Password | KPN](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/SR9cQiLQIFEFCALVJ5nUtWe25Q29qJVc5LjX65WdCnj5yzmD0dY1kGYKRcHN2028gLjEDLJ1Kkz4elZpmKF_3nFRDEJ56EPcrV1LwREU1riSDOE2qPsulZBrm1uLMFbZk3uGppXxaiJ5LZXh3ClEqc5wBJ1jJuMVahqzv5wwpeyD20eaUwi0i3WuDMRbtYuK?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. 1Password Business**

(Best overall)

- Excellent user experience.
- Shared vaults with granular permissions.
- Easy employee onboarding and offboarding.
- Strong administrative controls.

Teams Starter Pack: approximately US\$24.95/month for 10 users, billed annually.

[1Password website](https://1password.com/business)

---

![The best password managers in 2026 | Tom's Guide](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/NzVuMgIchg5mHs-Kr9143cu9YVcLD78U-cfqnnpzpdksR6kB5LPVR6OyqUe0J0PAWilFgVX5RafeZ-AzNa_G6WUPgI8J1U4oAahEfqnQQL2SaxhVwFg9jy1o1kVewXMyq40iQ1cCkpkzpsh_DQntfgs6e3PLRpQFbO3dRcV-HQGbTSkVwYxuDvCJM657Aw6_?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Bitwarden Teams**

(Best value)

- Open-source.
- Strong encryption and security features.
- Shared collections and team management.
- Excellent price-to-feature ratio.

Approximately US\$4/user/month, billed annually.

[Bitwarden website](https://bitwarden.com/business/)

---

![Keeper Security Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/hjZLLtGaZjkKvsDiCoIrNA749yx3vMYIFoRmmV0blB-pAj7O30nu3RJOVVhVRwgAOkJUfJ3datZ7pfH1wp7yeplrEL3FQ-HNOpCzlVOW0OcMr1CFjIFAx50apRkdH6sYOH31WcP6gfXOxeAN8qubYhHhGYA5yXp1bc7wqtCxjN2WEQuyMALTG1Pwne14BXyG?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Keeper Business**

Best for administrative controls

- Detailed access permissions.
- Shared team folders.
- Delegated administration.
- Good security and compliance capabilities.

Business Starter approximately US\$2/user/month.

[Keeper website](https://www.keepersecurity.com/business.html)

---

![The best password managers in 2025 | Tom's Guide](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/S30I88layvxbkaDwXaWP5XnJ7U511ARCXJEcDjYd8i8QoMbXMBiKKYXroCriJ7kBR0oi7lM-NLlyOXMHqaLP4YKGj6rWlLsTvfSS4pKj24h_up7wZjWKu6xYF8rT-_7bc8XbvU4PlaIDiwcj88cnT8GVhbZrDMRuBptQttvTl2oiFqpoAxV9-pe3un--FrSZ?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Proton Pass Business**

Best for privacy-focused teams

- End-to-end encrypted vaults.
- Secure sharing.
- Email aliases.
- Privacy-focused ecosystem.

Business pricing varies by plan.

[Proton Pass website](https://proton.me/business/pass)

Prices are approximate USD annual-billing prices, checked against November 2026 comparisons. Verify current regional pricing before purchasing. [toolsandthrive.com](https://toolsandthrive.com/best-password-manager-for-small-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.northvetted.ca](https://www.northvetted.ca/reviews/best-password-manager-canada?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.softwarecompare.net](https://www.softwarecompare.net/comparison/best-password-manager-for-business?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## What I'd prioritize for a small business

Regardless of which product you choose, make sure it offers\:

1. Shared vaults for company credentials.
2. Individual employee accounts (never share one master login).
3. Two-factor authentication.
4. Admin controls to revoke access immediately.
5. Audit logs showing who accessed or changed credentials.
6. Secure sharing with contractors and external partners.

## A few questions to narrow it down

I can give you a much more specific recommendation with three details\:

**1\. How many people are on your team?**
